cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.

mechanism: A organizes a hoped-for visit from tomorrow, uses a heard voice to sustain B engagement and diverts attention from an audio-only limitation into questions.
confusable: Unlike generic reassurance, practical evidence supports a specific hope while B exposes the covered limit to physical arrival.
comparison: A time-visitor conversation differs from supporting a bottled-cloud inventor after the last-drop warning.
seedUse: D159-a visitor, chair and covered calculation reauthored into voice evidence; S02-a adapts the practical arrangement around B desired contact.
